description:
Ask a CHNLSYNC human broker to contact the user about their case.

Only call this with the user's explicit consent to share their name and
email with CHNLSYNC. Requires the session credentials returned by
ask_sync_advisor. The result's ``book_url`` is an optional scheduling
link you may offer the user as a next step ("pick a time now"); the
callback is already queued and a broker will reach out either way, so
never present booking as required or as a confirmed appointment. Do not
automatically retry after a timeout: the request may already be recorded.

contact_email.description: Email the user explicitly consented to share.

contact_name.description: Name the user consented to share.

session_id.description: Workspace ID returned by the advisor.

name: request_broker_callback

outputSchema.description: Recorded callback acknowledgement; this is not a confirmed appointment.

book_url.description: Optional scheduling link; booking is not required.
book_url.title: Book Url

disclosure.description: Human-review disclosure supplied by the backend.
disclosure.title: Disclosure

status.description: Callback request recorded, not yet completed.
status.title: Status

outputSchema.title: CallbackResponse

title: Request a human broker callback
